acceptance_criteria: POST /devices/{deviceId}/delete endpoint exists and deletes the target device and its cascaded records (endpoints, device runs, projections, artefacts, and associated jobs/steps)
ActionRegistry defines DEVICE_DELETE and SecurityWebMvcConfig maps POST /devices/*/delete to DEVICE_DELETE requiring onboarding_admin role
DeviceRegistryPanel.tsx includes a delete action per device row with a confirmation dialog
DeviceWorkspaceScreen.tsx includes a delete device action button in header with confirmation dialog
No role literal strings in frontend (NoRoleConditionalRenderingInFrontendTest green)
All service tests (:service:test) and frontend CI (:frontendCi) pass

baseline.observed: There is currently no device deletion endpoint or UI action in UI2, making it impossible for operators to delete enrolled or draft devices from the database.
baseline.what_exists: DeviceRegistrationController provides POST /devices/add-single, GET /devices/{id}, and GET /devices. Devices table is referenced by foreign keys (endpoints, jobs, job_steps, job_step_attempt, device_inventory_run, device_configuration_run, configuration_artefact, configuration_notification, backup_artefact, backup_endpoint_ineligibility, cp_inventory_projection). Neither backend nor frontend exposes a delete action.

invariants: Strict role-based action gating (DEVICE_DELETE requires role:onboarding_admin)
Zero role string literals in frontend (NoRoleConditionalRenderingInFrontendTest)
Transactional cascaded deletion to ensure referential integrity
report.objective: Implement Device Deletion API (POST /devices/{deviceId}/delete) and UI deletion controls with confirmation in Device Management panel and Device Workspace.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Implementing device deletion API and UI controls

requirements: Add ActionRegistry.DEVICE_DELETE = 'device_delete' seeded with role:onboarding_admin requirement.
Add SecurityWebMvcConfig route mapping: Map.entry('POST /devices/*/delete', ActionRegistry.DEVICE_DELETE).

Implement DeviceDeletionService (or DeviceService method) to perform transactional cascaded deletion: remove job step attempts and steps for jobs targeting device, remove jobs, remove runs, projections, artefacts, endpoints, and the device record.
Add POST /devices/{deviceId}/delete to DeviceRegistrationController returning 200 { 'deleted': true, 'device_id': deviceId } or 404 NOT_FOUND.
Add deleteDevice API function in frontend/src/auth/adminApi.ts.
In DeviceRegistryPanel.tsx, add a delete button or menu action per device with confirmation dialog that calls deleteDevice and refreshes the list.
In DeviceWorkspaceScreen.tsx, add a Delete Device button in actions header that confirms deletion, calls deleteDevice, and navigates back to inventory.
Run ./ui2/gradlew -p ui2 :service:test :frontendCi to verify all tests pass.
risks: Foreign key constraint violation if cascaded deletion misses any dependent table.

entries.subject: Deletion persistence scope unavailable
entries.text: Scope conflict: DeviceDeletionService.java and DeviceRegistrationControllerTest.java do not exist. WORKER.md permits reading only eight named files and forbids reading persistence implementations or their tests. Cascaded deletion requires the exact persistence ownership, foreign-key ordering, and transaction pattern; implementing it without those files would be speculative and cannot meet the transactional referential-integrity invariant. Please authorize the minimum persistence source/test files needed for inspection, or provide the intended deletion service contract.

entries.subject: Persistence Scope and Deletion Contract Decision
entries.text: 1. Scope authorization: You are authorized to read and update: ui2/persistence/src/main/java/com/securityexpert/nexus/ui2/persistence/device/DeviceRepository.java, ui2/persistence/src/main/java/com/securityexpert/nexus/ui2/persistence/device/JooqDeviceRepository.java, ui2/service/src/main/java/com/securityexpert/nexus/ui2/service/boot/DeviceCompositionConfiguration.java, ui2/service/src/main/java/com/securityexpert/nexus/ui2/service/device/DeviceDeletionService.java (create new), ui2/service/src/test/java/com/securityexpert/nexus/ui2/service/device/DeviceDeletionServiceTest.java (create new). 2. Deletion contract: Add boolean deleteDevice(String deviceId, String actorFingerprint, String actionId) in DeviceRepository/JooqDeviceRepository executing inside auditedTransactionBoundary in exact foreign key order: job_step_attempt, job_steps, job_reconciliation, configuration_artefact, cp_inventory_projection, device_configuration_run, device_inventory_run, configuration_notification, backup_artefact, backup_endpoint_ineligibility, jobs, endpoints, devices. 3. Controller and Action: Map POST /devices/*/delete in SecurityWebMvcConfig to ActionRegistry.DEVICE_DELETE (role:onboarding_admin). Expose POST /devices/{deviceId}/delete in DeviceRegistrationController returning 200 with deleted=true or 404. 4. Frontend: Export deleteDevice in adminApi.ts. Add confirmation dialog before delete in DeviceRegistryPanel and DeviceWorkspaceScreen. Zero role string literals in frontend.
